moa: Fluorocycline (tetracycline-class) antibacterial; binds the bacterial 30S ribosomal subunit and inhibits protein synthesis

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 211109 ... This new drug application provides for the use of XERAVA (eravacycline) for injection, 50 mg per vial, for the treatment of complicated intra-abdominal infections in patients 18 years of age and older ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (electronic signature page dated 08/27/2018)

launch_evidence.quote: U.S. net sales of XERAVA, which was launched in October 2018, were $1.5 million and $3.2 million

series_end_reason: Latest published quarter at sourcing time (Innoviva Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, filed 2026-08-05).
notes: Scope is U.S. XERAVA net sales throughout. Tetraphase books ex-U.S. partner payments as 'License and collaboration revenue', so its 'Product revenue, net' is U.S. product sales; La Jolla labels the line 'XERAVA U.S. net sales' (renamed 'XERAVA U.S. net product sales' in 2022). Tetraphase's Q3 2018 release (2018-11-08) has no 'Product revenue, net' row (rows read: license revenue and total revenue only), and the launch was October 2018, so 2018Q4 is the first quarter. 2019Q4 comes from the quarterly table in the 10-K because no Q4 2019 release was found among Tetraphase's 8-K exhibits. 2020Q2 and 2020Q3 are La Jolla's own full-quarter figures including the days before its July 28, 2020 closing (post-closing portion of Q3 was 1.9); the four 2020 quarters (1.755, 1.5, 2.7, 2.3) sum to 8.255 against the 8.2 stated for the year in the 10-K, within the rounding of the one-decimal figures. 2021 quarters (1.8, 2.5, 2.9, 2.9) sum to the stated 10.1. La Jolla's 10-Qs and 10-K print these in millions to one decimal; no thousands-level figure exists for 2020Q2-2022Q2. After the series end: Innoviva (CIK 1080014) prints 'net sales of XERAVA' of 1.3 for August 22-September 30 2022 (partial quarter), 5.5 for August 22-December 31 2022, then 2.5, 4.5, 5.1, 5.2 for 2023Q1-Q4 and 4.8, 6.2, 4.2 for 2024Q1-Q3 (all customers, not U.S.-only). Its releases give XERAVA as a component of 'U.S. net product sales' for 2024Q3 2.3, 2024Q4 3.1, 2025Q1 3.2, 2025Q2 3.1, 2025Q3 3.2, 2025Q4 3.8, 2026Q1 2.5, 2026Q2 3.3 (millions). Extension to 2026Q2 (Innoviva rows): Innoviva's 10-Qs from the Q1 2025 10-Q print net product sales with a 'U.S.' section and a 'Rest of the world' section by product, and the Form 10-K for 2025 prints the same split for full years 2025, 2024 and 2023. The U.S. XERAVA row is the same scope as the earlier rows (U.S. customers). 2024Q1-Q3 are read from the prior-year columns of the 2025 10-Qs because Innoviva's own 2024 filings print only the all-customer figure; 2024Q4 and 2025Q4 are the 10-K full year less the nine-month 10-Q figure (the quarterly releases print 3.1 and 3.8). 2025Q4 and 2024Q4 sum checks: 2024 quarters 3,286 + 3,965 + 2,363 + 3,163 = 12,777; 2025 quarters 3,234 + 3,129 + 3,189 + 3,789 = 13,341, equal to the printed U.S. full years. The series therefore has no U.S. quarterly figure for 2022Q3-2023Q4 (declared in unreported_quarters). The all-customer XERAVA net sales that Innoviva printed for 2022Q3-2024Q3 are listed in the earlier note and were not spliced into this U.S. series. Rest-of-world XERAVA (Innoviva 10-Q, 2026Q2): 3,474 thousand.
search_log: Tetraphase (CIK 1373707) submissions: listed 8-K Item 2.02 exhibits and 10-Q/10-K 2018-2020. Releases for 2018Q3 (2018-11-08), 2018Q4 (2019-03-14), 2019Q1 (2019-05-08), 2019Q2 (2019-08-08), 2019Q3 (2019-11-12) read; 2018Q3 prints no product revenue row; 2018Q4 is the first 'Product revenue, net' (178). No Q4 2019 or Q1 2020 earnings-release exhibit exists in the 8-K list (2020-03-16 8-K exhibits are agreements); 2019Q4 taken from the 10-K quarterly table, 2020Q1 from the 10-Q.
No Tetraphase Q2 2020 report exists (acquired 2020-07-28); La Jolla's Q2 2020 10-Q (2020-08-06) prints 'U.S. net sales of XERAVA ... were $1.5 million' for the quarter.

La Jolla (CIK 920465) stopped filing earnings 8-Ks after 2020-01; XERAVA U.S. net sales read from MD&A prose of every 10-Q/10-K 2020Q2-2022Q2. Note the 'XERAVA | 511 | 866' rows in La Jolla's 10-Q/10-K tables are selling-and-marketing expense by product, not sales, and were not used.

Innoviva (CIK 1080014) 10-Q/10-K and 8-K Item 2.02 releases 2022Q3-2026Q2 read: XERAVA is printed on its own line but as all-customer 'net sales' until 2024Q3 and the customer mix includes ex-U.S. (Innoviva states the U.S. share of net product sales per period), so Innoviva is not joined.
Checked La Jolla 2020 10-K and 2021 10-K for pre-closing XERAVA: 10-K 2020 states 8.2 for twelve months including pre-acquisition, 4.2 after July 28, consistent with the quarters used.

Extension search (refresh to 2026Q2): data.sec.gov submissions for Innoviva (CIK 1080014); read every 10-Q, 10-K and 10-K/A from the Q3 2022 10-Q to the Q2 2026 10-Q and every Item 2.02 8-K exhibit 99.1 from 2022-11-09 to 2026-08-05 for XERAVA rows. 10-Qs and the 10-K for 2022 and 2023, 10-Q for 2024Q1-Q3 and the 10-K for 2024 print no XERAVA table row by geography; the 2024 10-K prints total XERAVA 21,385 / 17,320 / 5,480 (thousands, 2024/2023/2022).

First U.S./rest-of-world split by product: Form 10-Q for Q1 2025 (U.S. XERAVA 3,234 and 3,286). Form 10-K for 2025 gives U.S. XERAVA 13,341 / 12,777 / 12,441 for 2025 / 2024 / 2023 and rest of world 10,175 / 8,608 / 4,879; no 2022 U.S. split for the Innoviva period.
Form 10-K/A filings (2023-03-20, 2024-03-05, 2024-03-22, 2025-03-24, 2026-03-27) checked: no XERAVA product table row.
Innoviva 8-K releases for 2024Q3 and later give the U.S. XERAVA figure rounded to one decimal (2.3, 3.1, 3.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.8, 2.5, 3.3 million), consistent with the thousands-level figures used.

unreported_quarters.2022Q3: Ownership change and scope gap: La Jolla was acquired by Innoviva on August 22, 2022 and filed no report after its Q2 2022 10-Q. Innoviva (CIK 1080014) prints XERAVA for this period only as all-customer 'net sales of XERAVA' (U.S. and ex-U.S. customers together; 5,480 thousand for the period from the August 22, 2022 acquisition to December 31, 2022, Innoviva Form 10-K for 2024, Net Product Sales table), and its 10-Qs and 10-K for 2022 and 2023 have no U.S./rest-of-world table by product. The U.S. line is not written for this quarter and is not estimated.
unreported_quarters.2022Q4: Same gap as 2022Q3: Innoviva prints XERAVA only as all-customer net sales, with no U.S. split. Not written, not estimated.
unreported_quarters.2023Q1: Scope gap: Innoviva's 10-Qs and releases for this quarter print XERAVA only as all-customer net sales (2023Q1 2.5, 2023Q2 4.5, 2023Q3 5.1, 2023Q4 5.2 million); the first document that splits XERAVA into U.S. and rest of world is the Q1 2025 10-Q (prior-year column for 2024Q1). The Form 10-K for 2025 prints a U.S. XERAVA figure for full-year 2023 only (12,441 thousand, against 17,320 thousand total), so no 2023 quarter can be derived. No U.S. quarterly figure exists and none is estimated.
unreported_quarters.2023Q2: Same gap as 2023Q1: all-customer XERAVA net sales 4.5 million only.
unreported_quarters.2023Q3: Same gap as 2023Q1: all-customer XERAVA net sales 5.1 million only.
unreported_quarters.2023Q4: Same gap as 2023Q1: all-customer XERAVA net sales 5.2 million only; full-year 2023 U.S. XERAVA of 12,441 thousand is printed (Form 10-K for 2025) but the quarterly split is not.
